steps.label: Precondition: top-left corner (particle 0, pinned) starts at y=0
Precondition: top-right corner (particle 19, pinned) starts at y=0

Precondition: this preset spawns already flush against the always-on floor collider (y=0), unlike ClothWithSphere/ClothOnBox which spawn elevated -- there is no vertical room for it to fall, so unlike most of this group there is no falling 'change' to observe here (see 33_soft_cloth_sphere.json/32_soft_cloth_on_box.json for that)

Change: the resting configuration is a genuine stable fixed point, not merely momentarily static -- continuing to simulate another 100 steps produces the exact same extent (a regression that introduced drift/jitter in the pin or floor constraint would move this)
Invariant: pinned top-left corner did not move
Invariant: pinned top-right corner did not move
Invariant: unpinned particles also stay resting on the floor, not sinking through it
